Around_The_Worlds: Lie on a flat bench with a light dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs, palms facing up.
With your arms almost straight, sweep a wide arc out to the sides until the dumbbells are overhead.
Return along the same path. Use a light weight: the shoulder works in demanding positions.
Barbell_Guillotine_Bench_Press: Lie on the bench and grab the bar slightly wider than usual.
Lower the bar towards your upper chest, close to your neck, with your elbows flared.
Press until your arms are straight. It is risky: use a light weight and always have a spotter.
Bent-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands over your chest, elbows bent.
Take it behind your head until you feel the stretch, without changing the angle of your elbows.
Return to the top along the same arc.
Cable_Chest_Press: Stand with your back between two pulleys at chest height, a handle in each hand and one foot forward.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return with control until your hands are at chest height.
Cable_Iron_Cross: Stand between two high pulleys with a handle in each hand and your arms out to the sides.
With your elbows slightly bent, bring your hands down until they meet in front of your hips.
Return with control to the cross position.
Clock_Push-Up: Do a push-up and, as you come up, move your hands one step to the side while your feet pivot.
Keep going round like the hands of a clock until you complete the circle, then change direction.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press: Lie on the decline bench with your feet secured.
Unrack the bar with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders and lower it to your lower chest.
Press until your arms are straight. Ask for help to unrack and rack the bar.
Decline_Dumbbell_Bench_Press: Lie on the decline bench with your feet secured and a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your lower chest.
Press until your arms are straight.
Decline_Dumbbell_Flyes: Lie on the decline bench with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
With your elbows slightly bent, open your arms out to the sides until you feel the stretch.
Close them again in an arc.
Decline_Smith_Press: Place a decline bench under the Smith machine bar and lie down with your feet secured.
Release the safety hooks and lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press until your arms are straight and hook the bar again.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press_with_Neutral_Grip: Lie on a flat bench with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower them to the sides of your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight. The neutral grip is usually comfortable for the shoulders.
Flat_Bench_Cable_Flyes: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys and lie down with a handle in each hand over your chest.
With your elbows slightly bent, open your arms out to the sides until you feel the stretch.
Close them again in an arc.
Front_Raise_And_Pullover: Lie on a bench holding a light bar on your thighs with your arms straight.
Raise the bar in an arc over your chest until it is behind your head.
Return along the same path to your thighs.
Hammer_Grip_Incline_DB_Bench_Press: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and lie down with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower them to the sides of your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight.
Incline_Cable_Chest_Press: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys and lie down with a handle in each hand at chest height.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Incline_Cable_Flye: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys and lie down with a handle in each hand over your chest.
With your elbows slightly bent, open your arms until you feel the stretch.
Close them again in an arc.
Incline_Dumbbell_Bench_With_Palms_Facing: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and lie down with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower them to the sides of your chest and press until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes_-_With_A_Twist: Lie on an incline bench with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Open your arms out to the sides with your elbows slightly bent.
As you close them, rotate your wrists to finish with your little fingers together at the top and squeeze your chest.
Incline_Push-Up: Place your hands on a bench or raised surface, slightly wider than your shoulders, with your body straight.
Lower your chest towards the bench by bending your elbows.
Push until your arms are straight. It is easier than a floor push-up.
Incline_Push-Up_Medium: Place your hands on a bench shoulder-width apart, with your body straight.
Lower your chest towards the bench with your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Push until your arms are straight.
Incline_Push-Up_Reverse_Grip: Place your hands on a bench with your palms facing you, shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the bench with your elbows close to your body.
Push until your arms are straight.
Incline_Push-Up_Wide: Place your hands on a bench much wider than your shoulders, with your body straight.
Lower your chest towards the bench.
Push until your arms are straight.
Isometric_Wipers: Get into a push-up position with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Shift your weight towards one arm, bending it while the other stays almost straight.
Return to the centre and move to the other side, keeping your body straight throughout.
Leverage_Chest_Press: Sit in the machine with your back supported and the handles at chest height.
Press until your arms are straight.
Return with control without letting the weight touch the stack.
Leverage_Decline_Chest_Press: Sit in the decline press machine with your back supported.
Press the handles forward and down until your arms are straight.
Leverage_Incline_Chest_Press: Sit in the incline press machine with your back supported.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are straight.
Low_Cable_Crossover: Set the pulleys low and grab a handle in each hand. Step forward.
With your elbows slightly bent, raise your hands until they meet in front of your chest.
Return with control. It works the upper chest more.
Machine_Bench_Press: Lie or sit in the machine with the handles at chest height.
Press until your arms are straight.
Neck_Press: Lie on the bench and grab the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar towards the base of your neck with your elbows flared.
Press until your arms are straight. Use a light weight and always have a spotter.
One-Arm_Flat_Bench_Dumbbell_Flye: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand over your chest and the other hand holding the bench.
With your elbow slightly bent, open your arm out to the side until you feel the stretch.
Close it again. Do all the reps and switch arms.
One_Arm_Dumbbell_Bench_Press: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Lower it to the side of your chest without letting your body rotate.
Press until your arm is straight. Switch sides. It demands core stability.
Push-Ups_With_Feet_Elevated: Put your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, slightly wider than your shoulders.
With your body straight, lower until your face is close to the floor.
Push until your arms are straight.
Push_Up_to_Side_Plank: As you come up, turn your body to one side and raise one arm towards the ceiling into a side plank.
Return to the push-up position and repeat to the other side.
Pushups_Close_and_Wide_Hand_Positions: Do a push-up with your hands together under your chest.
Spread your hands much wider than your shoulders and do another push-up.
Alternate the two positions throughout the set.
Single-Arm_Cable_Crossover: Set a pulley high and grab the handle with one hand; stand side-on to the machine.
With your elbow slightly bent, bring your hand towards the opposite hip in an arc.
Return with control and switch sides.
Single-Arm_Push-Up: Get into a push-up position with your feet wide apart and one hand behind your back.
Lower with your body straight, without rotating your hips.
Push until your arm is straight. It is an advanced exercise.
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press: Place a flat bench under the Smith machine bar and lie down.
Release the safety hooks and lower the bar to your chest.
Press until your arms are straight and hook the bar again.
Smith_Machine_Decline_Press: Place a decline bench under the Smith machine bar and lie down with your feet secured.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press until your arms are straight.
Smith_Machine_Incline_Bench_Press: Place an incline bench under the Smith machine bar and lie down.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press until your arms are straight.
Standing_Cable_Chest_Press: With your back to a pulley at chest height, hold the handle in one or both hands with one foot forward.
Press forward until your arms are straight, without arching your back.
Straight-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands over your chest, arms almost straight.
Take it behind your head in an arc until you feel the stretch.
Return to the top along the same path.
Wide-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press: Lie on the bench and grab the bar much wider than your shoulders.
Lower it to your chest with control.
Press until your arms are straight. If your shoulders bother you, narrow your grip.
Wide-Grip_Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press: Lie on the decline bench with your feet secured and grab the bar much wider than your shoulders.
Lower it to your lower chest.
Press until your arms are straight. Ask for help to unrack and rack the bar.
Wide-Grip_Decline_Barbell_Pullover: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and a bar over your chest, using a wide grip.
With your arms almost straight, take it behind your head.
Bent-Arm_Barbell_Pullover: Lie on a bench with an EZ or straight bar over your chest, elbows bent.
Take it behind your head without changing the angle of your elbows.
Return to the top, squeezing your back and chest.
Cable_Incline_Pushdown: Place an incline bench facing a high pulley and lie on your back holding the bar overhead.
With your arms straight, bring the bar down to your thighs.
Elevated_Cable_Rows: Sit on a raised platform facing the low pulley, with your legs braced.
Pull the handle to your stomach with a straight back.
Return by straightening your arms; the height allows a greater stretch.
Kneeling_High_Pulley_Row: Kneel facing a high pulley with a bar or rope, arms stretched up.
Pull towards your chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Kneeling_Single-Arm_High_Pulley_Row: Kneel facing a high pulley with a handle in one hand.
Pull towards your side, driving your elbow down and back.
Return with control and switch arms.
Leverage_Iso_Row: Sit in the machine with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together; you can work one arm or both.
One_Arm_Lat_Pulldown: Sit at the pulldown machine with a handle in one hand.
Pull down, bringing your elbow to your side.
Come up with control, straightening your arm, and switch sides.
Rope_Straight-Arm_Pulldown: Attach a rope to the high pulley and grab it with your arms straight.
Lean your torso forward slightly and, without bending your elbows, bring the rope down to your thighs.
Shotgun_Row: Stand facing a low pulley with one foot forward and the handle in one hand.
Pull the handle towards your hip, driving your elbow back and rotating your torso slightly.
Return by straightening your arm and switch sides.
Straight-Arm_Pulldown: Attach a bar to the high pulley and grab it with your arms straight, shoulder-width apart.
Lean your torso forward slightly and, without bending your elbows, bring the bar down to your thighs.
Return with control to head height.
Underhand_Cable_Pulldowns: Sit at the pulldown machine and grab the bar with your palms facing you, shoulder-width apart.
Pull towards your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
V-Bar_Pulldown: Attach the V-handle to the high pulley and sit with your thighs secured.
Pull towards your upper chest with your elbows close to your body.
Come up with control, straightening your arms.
V-Bar_Pullup: Place a V-handle over the pull-up bar and grab it with both hands.
Pull until your chest nears the handle, elbows pointing down.
Wide-Grip_Pulldown_Behind_The_Neck: Sit at the pulldown machine and grab the bar very wide.
Tilt your head slightly forward and bring the bar down behind your neck only as far as is comfortable.
Come up with control. If your shoulders bother you, pull to the front instead.
Wide-Grip_Rear_Pull-Up: Hang from the bar with a very wide grip.
Pull, bringing the back of your neck towards the bar, only as far as is comfortable for your shoulders.
Lower with control. If you feel discomfort, do the pull-up to the front.
Alternating_Kettlebell_Row: With a kettlebell in each hand, lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Row one kettlebell towards your hip and lower it.
Repeat with the other and keep alternating.
Bent_Over_One-Arm_Long_Bar_Row: Set one end of the bar in a corner or holder and load the other. Stand to one side.
With your torso bent forward and your back straight, grab the bar with one hand near the plates.
Row towards your hip, driving your elbow back, and lower with control. Switch sides.
Bent_Over_Two-Arm_Long_Bar_Row: Set one end of the bar in a corner or holder and load the other. Straddle the bar.
With your torso bent forward, grab it with both hands just behind the plates.
Row towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together, and lower with control.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row_With_Palms_In: With a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing each other, lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Row the dumbbells towards your hips with your elbows close to your body.
Dumbbell_Incline_Row: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell hanging in each hand.
Row the dumbbells towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control. The bench stops you from swinging.
Incline_Bench_Pull: Lie face down on an incline bench with a barbell hanging in your hands.
Pull the bar towards the bench, driving your elbows back.
Leverage_High_Row: Sit in the machine with your thighs secured and grab the handles overhead.
Pull down and back, bringing your elbows to your sides.
Lying_Cambered_Barbell_Row: Lie face down on a high bench with a cambered bar hanging in your hands.
Pull towards the bench, driving your elbows back; the bend in the bar allows a longer range.
Lying_T-Bar_Row: Lie face down on the T-bar row machine with your chest supported.
Grab the handles and pull towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Middle_Back_Shrug: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Without bending your elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades together, pulling your shoulders back.
Hold for a second and return with control.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Row: Rest one hand and one knee on a bench, or lean forward with a straight back, with a kettlebell in the other hand.
Row the kettlebell towards your hip with your elbow close to your body.
Lower with control and switch sides.
One-Arm_Long_Bar_Row: Set one end of the bar in a corner and load the other.
With your torso bent forward and one hand on your knee, grab the bar with the other.
Row towards your hip and lower with control. Switch sides.
Reverse_Grip_Bent-Over_Rows: Grab the bar with your palms facing forward, shoulder-width apart, and lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Row the bar to your lower stomach with your elbows close to your body.
Seated_One-arm_Cable_Pulley_Rows: Sit at the row machine with a handle in one hand.
Row towards your hip, driving your elbow back, with a straight back.
Return by straightening your arm and switch sides.
Smith_Machine_Bent_Over_Row: Stand in the Smith machine with the bar at knee height and lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Grab the bar and row it to your lower chest.
T-Bar_Row_with_Handle: Set one end of the bar in a corner and load the other. Slide a V-handle under it, next to the plates.
With your torso bent forward and your back straight, row the handle towards your chest.
Barbell_Shrug_Behind_The_Back: Stand holding the bar behind your thighs, palms facing back.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold for a second and lower with control.
Cable_Shrugs: Stand facing a low pulley with a bar in your hands.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears without bending your elbows.
Hold for a second and lower with control.
Calf-Machine_Shoulder_Shrug: Stand in the standing calf machine with your shoulders under the pads but your feet flat.
Raise your shoulders as high as you can.
Hold for a second and lower with control.
Clean_Shrug: Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and a clean grip.
Bend your knees slightly and extend your hips and legs explosively while shrugging your shoulders.
Do not bend your elbows. Lower with control.
Leverage_Shrug: Stand in the shrug machine with the handles at your sides.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears.
Hold for a second and lower with control.
Smith_Machine_Behind_the_Back_Shrug: With your back to the Smith machine bar, hold it behind your thighs.
Raise your shoulders as high as you can.
Hold for a second and lower with control.
Smith_Machine_Upright_Row: Stand facing the Smith machine bar and hold it at thigh height with a close grip.
Pull up with your elbows high until your hands reach your chest.
Lower with control. Do not go higher if your shoulders bother you.
Snatch_Shrug: Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and a very wide grip.
Bend your knees slightly and extend explosively while shrugging your shoulders.
Standing_Dumbbell_Upright_Row: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Pull up with your elbows high until your hands reach chest height.
Upright_Cable_Row: Stand facing a low pulley with a short bar in your hands.
Pull up with your elbows high until the bar reaches your chest.
Deficit_Deadlift: Stand on a plate or low platform with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Bend your hips and knees with a straight back and grab the bar.
Stand up by pushing the floor away. The deficit lengthens the range: use less weight.
Hyperextensions_With_No_Hyperextension_B: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and have someone hold your ankles.
Lower your torso by bending at the hips with a straight back.
Come up until your torso is in line with your legs, without over-arching.
Rack_Pull_with_Bands: Set the bar on the rack pins at knee height and hook bands to the ends.
With a straight back, stand up: the resistance increases at the top.
Lower with control to the pins.
Rack_Pulls: Set the bar on the rack pins at knee height.
Grab it with a straight back and your chest up and stand up.
Lower with control to the pins.
Seated_Good_Mornings: Sit on a bench with the bar on your upper back.
With a straight back, lean your torso forward.
Come back up. Use a light weight.
Stiff_Leg_Barbell_Good_Morning: With the bar on your upper back and your legs almost straight.
Lean your torso forward, pushing your hips back, with a straight back.
Come back up by extending your hips. Use a moderate weight.
